channel.title: The KenjiAI Podcast
channel.description: Yousif Alias runs Media Traffics and KenjiAI. Since 2016 his team has run ads, funnels and AI call centers for business owners. These episodes come from his real Zoom trainings, webinars and team calls, cut down to the useful parts: how to get leads that actually pay, how to close on the call, and how to use AI without losing the human side of sales.

item.title: Sales Fixes Everything: Train Your AI, Then Pick Up the Phone
item.itunes:title: Sales Fixes Everything: Train Your AI, Then Pick Up the Phone
item.description:
From a Saturday webinar. Yousif explains why an AI agent you set up and forget will fail and how he reviews every call it books to rewrite its prompt, why you always pay for clients with either money or time, why buyers of a business care about clients and recurring revenue more than leads, and why a sales focus beats content, funnels and likes.
This episode is the short version. The full playbook, with the exact scripts, setups and live calls with Yousif, is inside Freedom Club. Join here: https://freedom.kenjiai.com/starthere
Full write-up: https://kenjiai.com/blog/podcast-sales-fixes-everything

item.title: Time or Money: How to Book Calls People Actually Show Up To
item.itunes:title: Time or Money: How to Book Calls People Actually Show Up To
